title: A LOCAL engine crash shows as a remote Pod drop: 'Pod may have run out of memory' toast + remote flips to disconnected
description: comfyController._onWsDropped (MPI-563/B4, written for Pod OOM) fires for the local-pinned engine too: Fabio's local Transcribe crashed ComfyUI (Qwen3-ASR access violation, 2026-10-12) and got two 'Remote engine disconnected / Pod' toasts and remote phase none->disconnected. Fix: local engine gets its own message and never emits remote:engine-dropped.
